svg.title: DeepSWE 1.1 pass@1 against cost per task
svg.desc: Scatter of 113 results: pass@1 on the vertical axis, cost per task (usd, log scale) on the horizontal; each model’s effort levels are joined in order from low to max.
svg.text: DeepSWE 1.1 pass@1 against cost per task
Each line joins one model’s effort levels from low to max. Labelled points are the best result per model and the cost frontier.
Reported by the model’s own lab
Run by an independent third party
